formula: (complete-ingest fresh-data-path cost + matched query cost) × accumulated matched query runtime

window.basis: producer start through producer DONE line (113,219,565,734 rows in 113,227 seconds)

shared_path_contract.attribution: The writer and MSK path is charged once, reused unchanged by both counterfactual read-path comparisons, and never split or doubled.

writer_capacity_assumption.cost_model: assumed active capacity multiplied by complete producer uptime
writer_capacity_assumption.evidence_scope: benchmark-owner-directed modeling assumption; not a reconstruction of the original run's charged_seconds
writer_capacity_assumption.basis: Subsequent capacity characterization reported that 32 RPU sustained the 1 million events/second target with a 5-second median lag, while 16 RPU did not keep up.
writer_capacity_assumption.applies_to: the shared Redshift writer plus MSK complete-ingest fresh-data path used unchanged by the SUPER and typed read alternatives

writer_workgroup.model: assumed active capacity multiplied by complete producer uptime
writer_workgroup.evidence_scope: benchmark-owner-directed modeling assumption; not a reconstruction of the original run's charged_seconds

excluded.redshift_managed_storage: Final storage snapshot is not time-integrated and is excluded from the main fresh-data-path comparison.
excluded.client_cross_az_transfer: Excluded by benchmark-owner policy, consistently with other systems.
excluded.reader_queries: Reported separately from committed hourly allocation evidence.

redshift_query_cost_contract.allocation_driver: statement elapsed_time / total statement elapsed_time in the statement start-hour
redshift_query_cost_contract.runner_field: billed_times (historical name; values are allocated compute RPU-seconds)
redshift_query_cost_contract.interpretation: normalized query-cost allocation, not a literal invoice reconstruction
redshift_query_cost_contract.input_mode: committed JSONL allocation populated post hoc from the committed hourly allocation artifact
